promotions.title: **General Bonus Terms and Conditions**
promotions.source_text: 1\. Our Flexi bonus system allows you to withdraw your cash balance at any time, however you will be required to forfeit your remaining bonus balance if you do so. 2\. Wagering requirements apply to all bonuses. Unless stated in the specific terms of a given bonus offer, the applicable bonus must be wagered thirty (30) times the value of the bonus granted. 3\. Different games contribute to wagering requirements at different rates. Please see the Game Contributions section below. 4\. Unless otherwise stated in the terms of an individual offer, all Flexi bonuses are valid for 7 days after the point of activation. If any associated wagering for the bonus hasn’t been met within the 7 day period, the current bonus balance will be removed from the account. 5\. Bonuses are only permitted once per person, household, family, household address, email address, credit card number or shared computer environment (example: a library, workplace, fraternity, university or school). Betway Casino reserves the right to void all winnings and play should this term be disregarded. 6\. Any progressive jackpot wins are automatically added to your cash balance. 7\. Any additional bonuses allocated will have wagering requirements that will be added to any existing wagering requirements outstanding on your bonus balance. 8\. All no deposit free bonus/free games/free spins expire after 7 days 9\. The maximum that can be withdrawn from a no deposit free bonus/free games/free spins is €/$50 10\. All accounts are reviewed for advantage play, as described in the Advantage Play section below. 11\. The following terms apply to Free or Bonus Spins: - Free or Bonus Spins are credited to your account, and can be played by loading the game referenced in the promotion, where you will be presented with an option to claim the spins. - Free or Bonus Spins cannot be exchanged for Free Casino Credits. - Winnings from Free or Bonus Spins will be credited as a bonus, and are subject to these General Bonus Terms and Conditions.

promotions.title: # Sports bonus
promotions.source_text: # Sports bonus [Click here for a quick Guide to Bonuses](https://betway.com/g/en/dyn/bonus) **Free Bet Refund & Cash Spins Welcome Offer** Betway offers all new Betway customers the option to choose our **Free Bet Refund & Cash Spins Welcome Offer** from the registration form. If you opt in by selecting this offer from the Welcome Offer Picker, you will get a Free Bet refund up to $100 if your first bet loses. And upon the placement of a qualifying bet, you will also receive 20 Spins on the Gates of Olympus slot game. Any winnings made from your Free Bet and Gates of Olympus Spins **will pay out as cash with no wagering requirements.** Example 1: Place a **1st** bet of $10 to receive the 20 Gates of Olympus Spins. The $10 bet loses, prompting the crediting of a $10 Free Bet upon settlement of this bet. Example 2: Place a **1st** bet of $80 to receive the 20 Gates of Olympus Spins. The $80 bet wins, meaning that no Free Bet refund is credited. Example 3: Place a **1st** bet of $200 to receive the 20 Gates of Olympus Spins. The $200 bet loses, prompting the crediting of a $100 Free Bet upon settlement of this bet. 01. This offer is only available to new customers at Betway. 02. To qualify for this offer, you must select this Free Bet Refund & Cash Spins Welcome Offer from the checklist during the registration process. 03. This offer is valid for 7 days from your new account being registered. 04. If you opt in to receive this offer during the registration process, you will automatically receive a Free Bet if your first bet loses, and you will also automatically receive 20 spins on Gates of Olympus. 05. The potential Free Bet refund will be automatically credited to the Free Bet Balance within 60 minutes, if the first bet placed settles as a loss. 06. The Free Bet will expire 7 days after being credited and all winnings won as a result of using the Free Bet will be paid out as cash. 07. The 20 Spins on Gates of Olympus (worth $0.20 per spin) are awarded within an hour of the first bet being placed. 08. Once credited, simply load Gates of Olympus to redeem your 20 Spins. 09. The 20 Spins will expire 7 days after they have been credited and all winnings won as a result of using the Spins will be paid out as cash.

promotions.source_text: We’re always looking for ways to make your gaming experience easier, we’ve listened to you and understand that players don’t enjoy being tied into wagering requirements or locked into obscure terms. Based on this we’ve introduced our new Flexi Bonus system – these are our new player focused bonuses that give you control over your gameplay like never before. Flexi Bonus allow you to withdraw your current cash balance at any time, regardless of if there are wagering requirements outstanding. It gives you the player the complete flexibility to walk away whenever you want. All our promotions have clear upfront terms and conditions and full terms are only ever one click away. Below you’ll find our helpful FAQ sections with everything that you could want to know about our bonuses: **Quick Guide to Bonuses** **Flexi Bonus - How it works** **General Bonus Terms and Conditions** **Easy Guide to Wagering Requirements and Game Contributions** At Betway we provide our players a number of offers on both sign up and throughout their time playing with us. promotions.title: **Quick Guide to Bonuses**
promotions.source_text: 1\. What is a Flexi Bonus? 2\. What are Match Bonuses, Free Credits, Free Bets, Free Spins, Bonus Spins? 3\. Are there wagering requirements on my bonus? 4\. When can I withdraw? 5\. Do I have to take a bonus? Customers will always need to opt in to receive a bonus. Bonuses are awarded after logging in or after depositing. **1\. What is a Flexi Bonus?** **Flexi Bonus** is the name for any bonus credited to your bonus balance. Essentially it gives you the flexibility to forfeit your bonus balance and withdraw your entire cash balance at any time without being tied in by the wagering requirements of the bonus. All bonuses will have wagering requirements attached which must be cleared before the bonus and any winnings associated in your bonus balance are available for withdrawal. Please refer to the "Easy Guide to Wagering Requirements and Game Contributions" section for more information. **2\. What are Match Bonuses, Free Credits, Free Bets, Free Spins, Bonus Spins?** All our bonuses will now be in the form of our new Flexi Bonus – we offer a range of different types of Flexi Bonus explained below: **Match Bonuses** are offers that give a customer a certain amount of extra bonus on top of their deposit. All bonuses credited to your bonus balance will be in the form of a Flexi bonus allowing you to withdraw your cash balance at any time and no longer tying you into wagering requirement. **Free Credits** are offers that do not require a deposit, they’re added to your bonus balance and as with all bonuses they have wagering requirements associated before the bonus balance and any associated winnings are available for withdrawal. **Free Spins** are awarded on a specific slot game or group of slot games after opting in without a deposit being needed to be made. Once awarded, simply load the slot game and select either ‘Use Free Games Now’ to begin play, ‘Use Later’ to use them later or ‘I do not want this Free Game Offer’ to remove the free spins. Winnings from free spins will be paid into your bonus balance in the form of a Flexi bonus. **Bonus Spins** are awarded on a specific slot game or group of slot games upon opting in and depositing. If you opt in by selecting this offer from the Welcome Offer Picker, you will get a Free Bet refund up to $100 if your first bet loses. And upon the placement of a qualifying bet, you will also receive 20 Spins on the Gates of Olympus slot game. Any winnings made from your Free Bet and Gates of Olympus Spins **will pay out as cash with no wagering requirements.** Example 1: Place a **1st** bet of $10 to receive the 20 Gates of Olympus Spins. The $10 bet loses, prompting the crediting of a $10 Free Bet upon settlement of this bet. Example 2: Place a **1st** bet of $80 to receive the 20 Gates of Olympus Spins. The $80 bet wins, meaning that no Free Bet refund is credited. Example 3: Place a **1st** bet of $200 to receive the 20 Gates of Olympus Spins. The $200 bet loses, prompting the crediting of a $100 Free Bet upon settlement of this bet. 01. This offer is only available to new customers at Betway. 02. To qualify for this offer, you must select this Free Bet Refund & Cash Spins Welcome Offer from the checklist during the registration process. 03. This offer is valid for 7 days from your new account being registered. 04. If you opt in to receive this offer during the registration process, you will automatically receive a Free Bet if your first bet loses, and you will also automatically receive 20 spins on Gates of Olympus. 05. The potential Free Bet refund will be automatically credited to the Free Bet Balance within 60 minutes, if the first bet placed settles as a loss. 06. The Free Bet will expire 7 days after being credited and all winnings won as a result of using the Free Bet will be paid out as cash. 07. The 20 Spins on Gates of Olympus (worth $0.20 per spin) are awarded within an hour of the first bet being placed. 08. Once credited, simply load Gates of Olympus to redeem your 20 Spins. 09. The 20 Spins will expire 7 days after they have been credited and all winnings won as a result of using the Spins will be paid out as cash. 10. This offer may not be claimed in conjunction with any other promotions currently offered by Betway Sports and is subject to on-going review. promotions.title: **Flexi Bonus – How it works**
promotions.source_text: Flexi Bonus is the name of our new bonus system that allows you to withdraw your cash balance **at any time.** It works on a principle we call \*Bonus to Cash ratio\*(BCR). BCR is the percentage split between your total cash balance and your current bonus balance. When you have an active Flexi Bonus and wager on a game, the amount you wager will come from your cash balance and your bonus balance at your BCR ratio at the time of the wager being placed. Winnings are also allocated back to your cash and bonus balance in the same ratio as they were placed. We have set out below some examples to explain this, based on a new customer who has signed up and deposited €/$20 and received a 100% match bonus (€/$20 bonus). **Example 1 – Deposit €/$20 and get €/$20 bonus** €/$20 Cash Balance and €/$20 Bonus balance would be a 50% / 50% BCR €/$20 Cash plus €/$20 Bonus = €/$40 total balance (50% made up of cash and 50% made up of bonus) **Using example 1 above** – If you wager €/$10, €/$5 will come from your cash balance and €/$5 from your bonus balance. If you win €/$20 from this wager, €/$10 (50% of the win) will go into your cash balance and €/$10 (50% of the win) will go into your bonus balance. The €/$25 cash balance is available for you to withdraw but the €/$25 bonus balance will be subject to wagering requirements. **Example 2 – Currently have €/$10 cash and €/$10 bonus balance and deposit €/$20 cash with no bonus match** €/$30 Cash Balance and €/$10 Bonus balance would be a 75% / 25% BCR €/$30 Cash plus €/$10 Bonus = €/$40 total balance (75% made up of cash and 25% made up of bonus) **Using example 2 above** – If you wager €/$10, €/$7.50 will come from your cash balance and €/$2.50 from your bonus balance. If you win €/$20 from this wager, €/$15 (75% of the win) will go into your cash balance and €/$5 (25% of the win) will go into your bonus balance. The €/$37.50 cash balance is available for you to withdraw but the €/$12.50 bonus balance will be subject to wagering requirements. **If you only use bonus as you have no cash balance** to wager, your Bonus to Cash ratio (BCR) will be 100%, and therefore all of your wagering and winnings will be debited/ credited from/to your bonus balance. **What happens when I complete wagering on a bonus –** when you complete the full wagering on the bonus, your entire bonus balance will be transferred to your Cash balance and become available for you to withdraw. **Remember** bonuses still have wagering requirements dependent on

promotions.source_text: Usually offers that provide cashback, free spins, and free bets are considered no deposit bonuses. That means users do not need to deposit any money to receive rewards. Some cashbacks, free spins, and free bet bonuses go under the “No deposit” category at MelBet because players do not need to deposit any amount. However, to be eligible for those bonuses they have to follow other requirements like placing bets on certain events or others. MelBet Cashback A cashback bonus is a promotion where players receive a percentage of their losses back as bonus funds. This type of bonus helps reduce risks by giving players a second chance to recover some of their lost bets. Cashback bonuses can be daily, weekly, or tied to specific games or events and often come with minimal or no wagering requirements, making them a valuable reward for regular players. The cashback is often realized in bonus points that can be used to bet on sports events or to play gambling games. You just need to choose the “Bonus points” instead of “Main account”: MelBet mobile website version MelBet desktop version Bettors at MelBet especially appreciate the “Weekly cashback in the app” because it has extremely affordable requirements: just install the MelBet app, place some bets, and receive 10% cashback. It’s definitely worth learning more about the MelBet weekly cashback and looking through the bonus rules. Besides, if you use the application and place bets every day for a week, you become eligible for the daily bonus program from MelBet. It’s called “Cashback rewards” and grants a 3% cashback on your total losses. Loyalty Program MelBet rewards its players with an exclusive loyalty program featuring 8 exciting levels. Every player starts at Level 1 (Copper) and can progress by simply enjoying their favorite casino games. The more you play, the higher you climb! The list of all the 8 loyalty program levels: VIP Status Cashback Experience Odds Copper

promotions.title: MelBet Cashback
promotions.source_text: A cashback bonus is a promotion where players receive a percentage of their losses back as bonus funds. This type of bonus helps reduce risks by giving players a second chance to recover some of their lost bets. Cashback bonuses can be daily, weekly, or tied to specific games or events and often come with minimal or no wagering requirements, making them a valuable reward for regular players. The cashback is often realized in bonus points that can be used to bet on sports events or to play gambling games. You just need to choose the “Bonus points” instead of “Main account”: ![Bet with bonus points on mobile version](https://guidebook.melbet.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/bet-with-bonus-points-mobile-version-498x1024.jpg) MelBet mobile website version ![Bet with bonus points on desktop](https://guidebook.melbet.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/bet-with-bonus-points-desktop-1024x518.png) MelBet desktop version Bettors at MelBet especially appreciate the “Weekly cashback in the app” because it has extremely affordable requirements: just install the MelBet app, place some bets, and receive 10% cashback. It’s definitely worth learning more about the MelBet weekly cashback and looking through the bonus rules. Besides, if you use the application and place bets every day for a week, you become eligible for the daily bonus program from MelBet. It’s called “Cashback rewards” and grants a 3% cashback on your total losses.

promotions.title: Akun Bonus MelBet
promotions.source_text: Untuk mempelajari cara bertaruh dengan bonus MelBet secara bijak, Anda juga perlu memahami istilah “akun bonus.” Ini adalah saldo akun terpisah tempat poin bonus, taruhan gratis, atau kredit promosi disimpan. Dana ini berbeda dari saldo akun utama dan tunduk pada persyaratan bonus MelBet tertentu sebelum dapat ditarik. Saat Anda mengklaim promosi (misalnya, bonus selamat datang, bonus deposit, atau cashback), dana bonus dikreditkan ke akun bonus Anda. Setelah persyaratan taruhan terpenuhi, sisa dana bonus (atau kemenangan) dipindahkan ke saldo akun utama, di mana dana tersebut dapat ditarik. Banyak orang bertanya bagaimana cara menarik bonus MelBet, artinya mereka ingin mencairkan dana bonus. Jawabannya selalu sama: tidak mungkin untuk mencairkan dana dari akun bonus, tetapi Anda dapat menggunakannya untuk membeli taruhan gratis dan putaran gratis di Toko Kode Promo.

promotions.title: Bonus Abuse:
promotions.source_text: Bonus Abuse: If MelBet detects fraudulent activity, duplicate accounts, or bonus abuse, they can cancel the bonus and winnings or even block the account. Bonus Expiry: Unused bonus funds or free spins typically expire after a set period, so always check the specific terms. MelBet Bonus Wagering Requirements MelBet bonuses come with wagering requirements which are specific conditions that determine how many times you must bet the bonus before cashing out. These requirements vary based on the type of bonus. General wagering rules: Minimum Deposit Requirement: Most bonuses require a minimum deposit to activate, such as 2 USD, 10 USD, or more, depending on the offer. Multiplier Requirement: Most MelBet bonuses must be wagered a set number of times (e.g., 5x, 30x). For example, if you receive a 20 USD bonus with a 5x wagering requirement, you must place 100 USD in qualifying bets before withdrawal (20 USD × 5 = 100 USD). Bet Type Restrictions: Many bonuses require accumulator bets, where: each bet must contain a minimum number of selections (e.g., 3 or more), each selection must have minimum odds (e.g., 1.40, 1.65, etc.). MelBet Bonus Account To learn how to bet with MelBet bonus wisely you also need to understand the term “bonus account.” It’s a separate account balance where bonus points, free bets, or promotional credits are stored. These funds are different from the main account balance and are subject to specific MelBet bonus requirements before they can be withdrawn. When you claim a promotion (e.g., a welcome bonus, deposit bonus, or cashback), the bonus funds are credited to your bonus account. Once wagering requirements are met, the remaining bonus funds (or winnings) are moved to the main account balance, where they can be withdrawn.

promotions.title: MelBet Bonus Day
promotions.source_text: MelBet Bonus Day There are 3 happy days for MelBet users when they get generous bonuses: Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Every promotion comes with its own set of wagering requirements, terms and conditions, so be sure to review the rules carefully to make the most of your rewards. MelBet Monday Bonus “Royal Monday” is another popular promo MelBet offers for its users. The bookmaker and online casino thinks that Mondays should not be tough and wants to cheer bettors with some extra cash. The MelBet Monday Bonus rules are the following: You can receive 100% of your deposit as a bonus, up to a maximum of 100 USD (or the equivalent in another currency). The minimum deposit to qualify is $5. You must enable participation in bonus offers in your account: go to My Account → Account Settings → Bonuses → Sports. You must wager 6 times the bonus amount within 24 hours. Bets must be accumulator bets (a combo of multiple events). Each accumulator must have at least 3 selections. Each selection must have odds of 1.65 or higher. If you don’t complete the wagering within 24 hours, the bonus will expire. MelBet Wednesday Bonus This could be your lucky winning Wednesday at MelBet! With the “Fast Games Day” promotion, you can get a 100% bonus on your deposit, up to 111 USD (or the same amount in another currency). The rules are as follows: The minimum deposit required is 2 USD (or its equivalent in your local currency). Bonus cannot be combined with other promotions. Not all Fast Games are eligible – excluded titles include Lucky Wheel, Crash, Jackpot Game, Royal Feast, and others. Switch to your bonus account and wager the bonus 30 times in games from the Fast Games section. This must be done within 24 hours of receiving the bonus.

promotions.title: **Bono de Depósito de MelBet**
promotions.source_text: Un bono de depósito es una recompensa especial que se otorga cuando un jugador recarga su cuenta. Normalmente, el bono de depósito es un porcentaje del monto del pago — por ejemplo, un bono del 100% significa que si depositas $50, obtienes $50 adicionales como fondos de bono. Eso quiere decir que cuanto más deposites, más dinero de bono recibirás. MelBet ofrece una variedad de bonos de depósito atractivos, incluidos algunos de los incentivos más populares: Bono de Bienvenida, Bono de Casino, Serie de Depósitos, Lunes Real, Día de Juegos Rápidos.

promotions.title: Bonus Rabu MelBet
promotions.source_text: Ini bisa menjadi hari Rabu keberuntungan Anda di MelBet! Dengan promosi “Fast Games Day”, Anda bisa mendapatkan bonus 100% dari deposit Anda, hingga 111 USD (atau jumlah yang sama dalam mata uang lain). Aturannya adalah sebagai berikut: - Deposit minimum yang diperlukan adalah 2 USD (atau setara dalam mata uang lokal Anda). - Bonus tidak dapat digabungkan dengan promosi lain. - Tidak semua Fast Games memenuhi syarat – judul yang dikecualikan termasuk Lucky Wheel, Crash, Jackpot Game, Royal Feast, dan lainnya. - Beralih ke akun bonus Anda dan pasang taruhan bonus sebesar 30 kali dalam permainan dari bagian Fast Games. Ini harus dilakukan dalam 24 jam setelah menerima bonus. - Bonus dan kemenangan apa pun akan dicabut setelah 24 jam jika taruhan penuh tidak diselesaikan. - Taruhan hanya dianggap selesai setelah semua permainan yang dimainkan dengan bonus telah selesai. - Jika Anda menarik dana sebelum melakukan deposit, bonus tidak akan dikreditkan. - Jika berhasil, sisa dana bonus hingga jumlah bonus awal akan ditransfer ke saldo utama Anda. - Jika akun bonus Anda memiliki kurang dari jumlah taruhan minimum, sisa bonus akan hangus.

promotions.title: Bonus Jumat MelBet
promotions.source_text: Penawaran ini tersedia dalam promosi “Members Only” setiap hari Jumat dan dianggap sebagai bonus deposit, karena Anda perlu mengisi saldo akun untuk mendapatkan manfaatnya. Untuk mendapatkan bonus, Anda perlu melakukan hal berikut: 1. **Lakukan deposit pada hari Jumat:** Untuk memenuhi syarat penawaran, Anda perlu mendepositkan minimal 10 USD (atau setara dalam mata uang lain) ke akun Anda pada hari Jumat. 2. **Dapatkan putaran gratis berdasarkan saldo yang ada:** Sebelum melakukan deposit, jika Anda sudah memiliki uang di saldo akun utama Anda, Anda dapat memperoleh 1 putaran gratis (FS) dalam permainan Mariachi Afortunado oleh Mancala untuk setiap 5 USD dalam saldo Anda. Misalnya, jika Anda memiliki 20 USD sebelum mendepositkan, Anda mendapatkan 4 putaran gratis. 3. **Terima bonus tunai 50%:** Setelah melakukan deposit, Anda akan menerima bonus 50% dari jumlah yang didepositkan – hingga maksimum 100 USD. Misalnya, jika Anda mendepositkan 50 USD, Anda mendapatkan bonus 25 USD. Jika Anda mendepositkan 200 USD, Anda tetap hanya mendapatkan bonus maksimum 100 USD.

promotions.title: Persyaratan Taruhan Bonus MelBet
promotions.source_text: Bonus MelBet hadir dengan persyaratan taruhan yang merupakan kondisi khusus yang menentukan berapa kali Anda harus memasang taruhan bonus sebelum mencairkannya. Persyaratan ini bervariasi berdasarkan jenis bonus. Aturan taruhan umum: 1. **Persyaratan Deposit Minimum:** Sebagian besar bonus memerlukan deposit minimum untuk diaktifkan, seperti 2 USD, 10 USD, atau lebih, tergantung pada penawaran. 2. **Persyaratan Multiplier:** Sebagian besar bonus MelBet harus dipasang taruhan sejumlah waktu yang ditentukan (misalnya, 5x, 30x). Misalnya, jika Anda menerima bonus 20 USD dengan persyaratan taruhan 5x, Anda harus memasang 100 USD dalam taruhan yang memenuhi syarat sebelum penarikan (20 USD × 5 = 100 USD). 3. **Pembatasan Jenis Taruhan:**Banyak bonus memerlukan taruhan akumulator, di mana: - setiap taruhan harus mengandung jumlah pilihan minimum (misalnya, 3 atau lebih), - setiap pilihan harus memiliki odds minimum (misalnya, 1,40, 1,65, dll.).

Beberapa di antaranya berlaku secara eksklusif dalam disiplin olahraga tertentu atau turnamen tertentu (misalnya, Grand Slam – Grand Win didedikasikan untuk tenis, Indian Champion’s League mengacu pada kompetisi kriket yang terkenal). - **Kasino:** Ini adalah daftar bonus kasino MelBet yang komprehensif yang mewakili penawaran aktif. Para penjudi di seluruh dunia menghargai insentif bonus permainan MelBet karena kedermawanannya dan persyaratan taruhan yang terjangkau. - **Bonus Esports:** Untuk para penggemar eSports, MelBet menawarkan sejumlah insentif dengan taruhan gratis. - **FAST GAMES:** Dapatkan uang gratis di akun bonus Anda dan putaran gratis untuk permainan tertentu, menangkan headset VR, smartphone, konsol game, atau taruhan gratis dalam berbagai turnamen FAST GAMES. - **Semua Penawaran:** Pilih grup ini jika Anda ingin melihat semua promosi MelBet.

promotions.title: MelBet Bonus di Deposito
promotions.source_text: Bonus deposit adalah hadiah khusus yang diberikan ketika pemain mengisi saldo akun mereka. Biasanya, bonus deposit adalah persentase dari jumlah pembayaran – misalnya, bonus deposit 100% berarti jika Anda mendepositkan $50, Anda mendapatkan tambahan $50 sebagai dana bonus. Artinya, semakin banyak yang Anda depositkan, semakin banyak uang bonus yang Anda terima. MelBet menawarkan berbagai bonus deposit yang menarik, termasuk beberapa insentif paling populer: Bonus Selamat Datang, Bonus Kasino, Seri Deposit, Royal Monday, Fast Games Day.

promotions.title: Bonus Tanpa Deposit MelBet
promotions.source_text: Biasanya penawaran yang memberikan cashback, putaran gratis, dan taruhan gratis dianggap sebagai bonus tanpa deposit. Artinya pengguna tidak perlu mendepositkan uang apa pun untuk menerima hadiah. Beberapa cashback, putaran gratis, dan bonus taruhan gratis masuk dalam kategori “Tanpa Deposit” di MelBet karena pemain tidak perlu mendepositkan jumlah berapa pun. Namun, untuk memenuhi syarat bonus tersebut, mereka harus memenuhi persyaratan lain seperti memasang taruhan pada acara tertentu atau persyaratan lainnya.
promotions.cluster_label: Deposit Bonus · Eligible Users · All Sports

promotions.title: Bonus Rabu MelBet
promotions.source_text: Ini bisa menjadi hari Rabu keberuntungan Anda di MelBet! Dengan promosi “Fast Games Day”, Anda bisa mendapatkan bonus 100% dari deposit Anda, hingga 111 USD (atau jumlah yang sama dalam mata uang lain). Aturannya adalah sebagai berikut: - Deposit minimum yang diperlukan adalah 2 USD (atau setara dalam mata uang lokal Anda). - Bonus tidak dapat digabungkan dengan promosi lain. - Tidak semua Fast Games memenuhi syarat – judul yang dikecualikan termasuk Lucky Wheel, Crash, Jackpot Game, Royal Feast, dan lainnya. - Beralih ke akun bonus Anda dan pasang taruhan bonus sebesar 30 kali dalam permainan dari bagian Fast Games. Ini harus dilakukan dalam 24 jam setelah menerima bonus. - Bonus dan kemenangan apa pun akan dicabut setelah 24 jam jika taruhan penuh tidak diselesaikan. - Taruhan hanya dianggap selesai setelah semua permainan yang dimainkan dengan bonus telah selesai. - Jika Anda menarik dana sebelum melakukan deposit, bonus tidak akan dikreditkan. - Jika berhasil, sisa dana bonus hingga jumlah bonus awal akan ditransfer ke saldo utama Anda. - Jika akun bonus Anda memiliki kurang dari jumlah taruhan minimum, sisa bonus akan hangus.
promotions.cluster_label: Deposit Bonus · Eligible Users · All Sports

promotions.title: Bonus Jumat MelBet
promotions.source_text: Penawaran ini tersedia dalam promosi “Members Only” setiap hari Jumat dan dianggap sebagai bonus deposit, karena Anda perlu mengisi saldo akun untuk mendapatkan manfaatnya. Untuk mendapatkan bonus, Anda perlu melakukan hal berikut: 1. **Lakukan deposit pada hari Jumat:** Untuk memenuhi syarat penawaran, Anda perlu mendepositkan minimal 10 USD (atau setara dalam mata uang lain) ke akun Anda pada hari Jumat. 2. **Dapatkan putaran gratis berdasarkan saldo yang ada:** Sebelum melakukan deposit, jika Anda sudah memiliki uang di saldo akun utama Anda, Anda dapat memperoleh 1 putaran gratis (FS) dalam permainan Mariachi Afortunado oleh Mancala untuk setiap 5 USD dalam saldo Anda. Misalnya, jika Anda memiliki 20 USD sebelum mendepositkan, Anda mendapatkan 4 putaran gratis. 3. **Terima bonus tunai 50%:** Setelah melakukan deposit, Anda akan menerima bonus 50% dari jumlah yang didepositkan – hingga maksimum 100 USD. Misalnya, jika Anda mendepositkan 50 USD, Anda mendapatkan bonus 25 USD. Jika Anda mendepositkan 200 USD, Anda tetap hanya mendapatkan bonus maksimum 100 USD.

promotions.title: Bonus Ulang Tahun MelBet
promotions.source_text: Bonus Ulang Tahun MelBet adalah promosi khusus yang dirancang untuk membuat ulang tahun Anda semakin istimewa. Ini menawarkan hadiah untuk meningkatkan pengalaman taruhan dan bermain game Anda di platform. Bonus ini adalah cara yang bagus bagi MelBet untuk menghargai pemain setia, dan fitur tanpa persyaratan taruhannya membuatnya menonjol dibandingkan promosi lainnya. Persyaratan bonus ulang tahun MelBet: - **Usia Akun:** Akun MelBet Anda harus terdaftar setidaknya 30 hari sebelum ulang tahun Anda. - **Kelengkapan Profil:** Pastikan semua detail pribadi (nama lengkap, tanggal lahir, nomor telepon, email) diisi di “My Account” dan diverifikasi (telepon melalui SMS, email diaktifkan). - **Aktivasi Bonus:** Aktifkan “Ikut serta dalam penawaran bonus” di bawah Pengaturan Akun > Bonus > Kasino. - **Deposit:** Telah mendepositkan setidaknya €100 (atau setara dalam mata uang lokal Anda) dalam 30 hari sebelum ulang tahun Anda. - **Permainan:** Putaran gratis untuk Sweet Bonanza oleh Pragmatic Play, atau permainan pengganti jika tidak tersedia di wilayah Anda. - **Tanpa Kripto:** Deposit cryptocurrency tidak memenuhi syarat.
promotions.cluster_label: Deposit Bonus · Eligible Users · All Sports

promotions.title: Persyaratan Taruhan Bonus MelBet
promotions.source_text: Bonus MelBet hadir dengan persyaratan taruhan yang merupakan kondisi khusus yang menentukan berapa kali Anda harus memasang taruhan bonus sebelum mencairkannya. Persyaratan ini bervariasi berdasarkan jenis bonus. Aturan taruhan umum: 1. **Persyaratan Deposit Minimum:** Sebagian besar bonus memerlukan deposit minimum untuk diaktifkan, seperti 2 USD, 10 USD, atau lebih, tergantung pada penawaran. 2. **Persyaratan Multiplier:** Sebagian besar bonus MelBet harus dipasang taruhan sejumlah waktu yang ditentukan (misalnya, 5x, 30x). Misalnya, jika Anda menerima bonus 20 USD dengan persyaratan taruhan 5x, Anda harus memasang 100 USD dalam taruhan yang memenuhi syarat sebelum penarikan (20 USD × 5 = 100 USD). 3. **Pembatasan Jenis Taruhan:**Banyak bonus memerlukan taruhan akumulator, di mana: - setiap taruhan harus mengandung jumlah pilihan minimum (misalnya, 3 atau lebih), - setiap pilihan harus memiliki odds minimum (misalnya, 1,40, 1,65, dll.).

promotions.title: Penutup
promotions.source_text: MelBet percaya pada pemberian penghargaan kepada pemainnya, membuat setiap taruhan lebih menarik dan setiap kemenangan semakin manis. Dari penawaran selamat datang yang generous hingga promosi berkelanjutan, bonus-bonus ini membantu mengubah setiap momen menjadi peluang menang. Tetap terinformasi, klaim hadiah Anda, dan manfaatkan setiap taruhan sebaik-baiknya – karena di MelBet, setiap pemain berhak mendapatkan sedikit keberuntungan ekstra. Banyak bonus MelBet menggabungkan beberapa jenis insentif. Misalnya, kode **GUIDE777** ini sebenarnya menggabungkan kode promo MelBet dan bonus deposit sekaligus. Jadi, penting untuk membaca syarat dan ketentuan setiap bonus yang Anda rencanakan untuk digunakan secara menyeluruh.

MelBet Bonus Account To learn how to bet with MelBet bonus wisely you also need to understand the term “bonus account.” It’s a separate account balance where bonus points, free bets, or promotional credits are stored. When you claim a promotion (e.g., a welcome bonus, deposit bonus, or cashback), the bonus funds are credited to your bonus account. Once wagering requirements are met, the remaining bonus funds (or winnings) are moved to the main account balance, where they can be withdrawn. Many people ask how to withdraw the MelBet bonus, meaning they want to cash out bonus funds. The answer is always the same: it’s impossible to cash out the funds from the bonus account but you can use it to buy free bets and free spins at the Promo code store. promotions.title: **Reembolso de MelBet**
promotions.source_text: Un bono de reembolso es una promoción en la que los jugadores reciben un porcentaje de sus pérdidas de vuelta como fondos de bono. Este tipo de bono ayuda a reducir riesgos al brindarles a los jugadores una segunda oportunidad de recuperar parte de sus apuestas perdidas. Los bonos de reembolso pueden ser diarios, semanales o estar vinculados a juegos o eventos específicos, y a menudo vienen con requisitos de apuesta mínimos o nulos, lo que los convierte en una recompensa valiosa para los jugadores frecuentes. El reembolso suele recibirse en forma de puntos de bono que se pueden usar para apostar en eventos deportivos o jugar en juegos de azar. Solo necesitas seleccionar la opción “Puntos de bono” en lugar de “Cuenta principal”: ![Apuesta con puntos de bono en la versión móvil](https://guidebook.melbet.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/bet-with-bonus-points-mobile-version-498x1024.jpg) Versión móvil del sitio web de MelBet ![Apuesta con puntos de bono en la versión de escritorio](https://guidebook.melbet.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/bet-with-bonus-points-desktop-1024x518.png) Versión de escritorio del sitio web de MelBet Los apostadores de MelBet aprecian especialmente el “Reembolso semanal en la app” porque tiene requisitos muy accesibles: solo instala la aplicación de MelBet, realiza algunas apuestas y recibe un reembolso del 10%. Definitivamente vale la pena aprender más sobre el reembolso semanal de MelBet y revisar las reglas del bono. Además, si usas la aplicación y apuestas todos los días durante una semana, te vuelves elegible para el programa diario de bonos de MelBet. promotions.source_text: የጉርሻ ኮዶች በኦንላይን ካሲኖዎች እና ውርርድ መድረኮች ተጫዋቾቹ ልዩ ማስታወቂያዎችን ለመክፈት የሚያስገቧቸው ልዩ የፊደል ቁጥሮች ናቸው። እነዚህ ኮዶች በማስታወቂያው ላይ በመመስረት ነፃ ስፖንሰር፣ የተቀማጭ ጉርሻዎች፣ የገንዘብ ተመላሽ ቅናሾች ወይም ነጻ ውርርድ ሊሰጡ ይችላሉ። ለመመዝገብ ላቀዱ አዲስ ተጠቃሚዎች ይህ የሜልቤት ቦነስ ማስተዋወቂያ ኮድ – **GUIDE777** – ለ”እንኳን ደህና መጣችሁ ጉርሻ” የተሻሻሉ ሁኔታዎችን ያቀርባል። ተጨዋቾች ሽልማቱን ለማስጀመር በምዝገባ ፣በማስቀመጥ ወይም በልዩ ማስታወቂያ ክፍል ውስጥ ብዙውን ጊዜ የጉርሻ ኮዶችን ያስገባሉ። ነገር ግን፣ አብዛኛዎቹ ኮዶች ማንኛውንም አሸናፊነት ከማውጣትዎ በፊት መሟላት ያለባቸው እንደ መወራረድም መስፈርቶች እና የአገልግሎት ማብቂያ ቀኖች ካሉ ውሎች እና መመሪያወች ጋር አብረው ይመጣሉ። የጉርሻ ነጥቦችዎን ለነፃ ውርርዶች ወይም ለነፃ የጨዋታ ክፍለ ጊዜዎች ለመቀየር የማስታወቂያ ኮድ ማከማቻን ያረጋግጡ። ለጉርሻ ነጥቦችዎ የማስታወቂያ ኮዶችን ሲገዙ አንድ ወይም ከዚያ በላይ ምድቦችን መምረጥ ይችላሉ፡ ውርርድ፣ ስፖርት፣ ጨዋታዎች እና ኢስፖርቶች፡ ![በመተግበሪያ ውስጥ የማስታወቂያ ኮድ ማከማቻ](https://guidebook.melbet.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/promo-code-store-app-461x1024.jpg) MelBet መተግበሪያ ![በተንቀሳቃሽ ስልክ ስሪት ላይ የማስተዋወቂያ ኮድ ማከማቻ](https://guidebook.melbet.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/promo-code-store-mobile-version-497x1024.jpg) የድረ ገጽ የሞባይል ስሪት ![በዴስክቶፕ ላይ የማስታወቂያ ኮድ ማከማቻ](https://guidebook.melbet.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/promo-code-store-desktop-1024x518.jpg) የድረ ገጽ ዴስክቶፕ ስሪት በዚህ ምክንያት በተወሰኑ ውርርድ አማራጮች እና የቁማር ጨዋታዎች ውስጥ ጥቅም ላይ ሊውሉ የሚችሉ የMelBet ምንም የተቀማጭ ጉርሻ ኮድ ያገኛሉ። የሚያስፈልግህ ነገር ቢኖር በተዘጋጀው መስክ ውስጥ ኮዱን ማስገባት ብቻ ነው፡- ![በመተግበሪያ ውስጥ የጉርሻ ኮድን በመጠቀም እንዴት መወራረድ እንደሚቻል](https://guidebook.melbet.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/bet-with-bonus-code-app-461x1024.jpg) MelBet መተግበሪያ ![በሞባይል ሥሪት ላይ የጉርሻ ኮድን በመጠቀም እንዴት መወራረድ እንደሚቻል](https://guidebook.melbet.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/bet-with-bonus-code-mobile-version-501x1024.jpg) የMelBet የሞባይል ድረ ገጽ ![በዴስክቶፕ ላይ የጉርሻ ኮድ በመጠቀም እንዴት መወራረድ እንደሚቻል](https://guidebook.melbet.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/bet-with-bonus-code-desktop-1024x522.jpg) የMelBet ዴስክቶፕ ድረ ገጽ

promotions.title: MelBet ካሽባክ
promotions.source_text: የጥሬ ገንዘብ (ካሽባክ)ተመላሽ ጉርሻ ተጫዋቾች የኪሳራቸዉን መቶኛ እንደ ቦነስ ፈንድ የሚቀበሉበት ማስታወቂያ ነው። ይህ ዓይነቱ ጉርሻ ለተጫዋቾች የጠፉትን ውርርድ መልሶ ለማግኘት ሁለተኛ እድል በመስጠት አደጋዎችን ለመቀነስ ይረዳል። የመመለሻ ጉርሻዎች በየቀኑ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ ፣ የመመለሻ ጉርሻዎች በየቀኑ፣ በየሳምንቱ ወይም ከተወሰኑ ጨዋታዎች ወይም ዝግጅቶች ጋር የተሳሰሩ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ እና ብዙ ጊዜ በትንሹ ወይም ምንም የውርርድ መስፈርቶች ጋር ይመጣሉ፣ ይህም ለመደበኛ ተጫዋቾች ጠቃሚ ሽልማት ያደርጋቸዋል። የጥሬ ገንዘብ ተመላሽ ብዙውን ጊዜ በስፖርት ዝግጅቶች ላይ ለውርርድ ወይም የቁማር ጨዋታዎችን ለመጫወት በሚጠቅሙ የጉርሻ ነጥቦች ውስጥ ይስተዋላል። ከ“ዋና መለያ” ይልቅ “የጉርሻ ነጥቦችን” መምረጥ ብቻ ያስፈልግዎታል፡- ![በሞባይል ሥሪት ላይ ከጉርሻ ነጥቦች ጋር ውርርድ](https://guidebook.melbet.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/bet-with-bonus-points-mobile-version-498x1024.jpg) MelBet የሞባይል ድረ ገጽ ስሪት ![በዴስክቶፕ ላይ ከጉርሻ ነጥቦች ጋር ውርርድ](https://guidebook.melbet.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/bet-with-bonus-points-desktop-1024x518.png) MelBet የዴስክቶፕ ስሪት በሜልቤት ላይ ያሉ ተወራራጆች በተለይ “በመተግበሪያው ውስጥ ያለው ሳምንታዊ ገንዘብ ተመላሽ” በጣም ያደንቃሉ ምክንያቱም እጅግ በጣም ተመጣጣኝ መስፈርቶች አሉት፡ የሜልቤት መተግበሪያን ብቻ ይጫኑ፣ አንዳንድ ውርርድ ያስቀምጡ እና 10% ተመላሽ ገንዘብ ይቀበሉ። በእርግጠኝነት ስለ MelBet ሳምንታዊ የገንዘብ ተመላሽ ገንዘብ የበለጠ መማር እና የጉርሻ ህጎችን መመልከት ጠቃሚ ነው። በተጨማሪም አፕሊኬሽኑን ከተጠቀሙ እና ለሳምንት በየቀኑ ውርርድ ካስቀመጡ ከሜልቤት ለዕለታዊ ጉርሻ ፕሮግራም ብቁ ይሆናሉ። «የገንዘብ ተመላሽ ሽልማቶች» ይባላል እና ለጠቅላላ ኪሳራዎ 3% ተመላሽ ገንዘብ ይሰጣል።

promotions.title: የMelBet ሰኞ ጉርሻ
promotions.source_text: “ሮያል ሰኞ” ሜልቤት ለተጠቃሚዎቹ የሚያቀርበው ሌላ ታዋቂ ማስተዋወቂያ ነው። ድርጅቱ እና የመስመር ላይ ካሲኖ ሰኞ ጠንከር ያለ መሆን እንደሌለበት ያስባል እና በአንዳንድ ተጨማሪ ገንዘብ ተወራራጆችን ማበረታታት ይፈልጋል። የሜልቤት ሰኞ ጉርሻ ህጎች የሚከተሉት ናቸው። - የተቀማጭዎትን 100% እንደ ቦነስ፣ እስከ ከፍተኛው 100 ዶላር (ወይንም በሌላ ተመጣጣኝ ምንዛሪ) መቀበል ይችላሉ። - ብቁ ለመሆን የሚያስቀምጠው ዝቅተኛው $5 ነው። - በመለያዎ ውስጥ በጉርሻ ቅናሾች ውስጥ መሳተፍን ማንቃት አለብዎት፡ ወደ የእኔ መለያ(My Account) → መለያ ቅንብሮች(Settings) → ጉርሻዎች(Bonuses) → ስፖርቶች(Sports) ይሂዱ። - በ24 ሰአታት ውስጥ የቦነሱን መጠን 6 እጥፍ መወራረድ አለቦት። - ውርርዶች የአኩሙሌተር ውርርድ (የብዙ ክስተቶች ጥምር) መሆን አለባቸው። - እያንዳንዱ አኩሙሌተር ቢያንስ 3 ምርጫዎች ሊኖሩት ይገባል። - እያንዳንዱ ምርጫ 1.65 ወይም ከዚያ በላይ ዕድሎች ሊኖሩት ይገባል። - መወራረዱን በ24 ሰአታት ውስጥ ካላጠናቀቁ፣ ጉርሻው ጊዜው ያልፍበታል።

promotions.title: Syarat dan Ketentuan Bonus MelBet
promotions.source_text: Syarat dan Ketentuan adalah seperangkat aturan, panduan, dan perjanjian hukum yang mendefinisikan bagaimana suatu layanan, produk, atau penawaran dapat digunakan. Syarat dan Ketentuan Bonus MelBet mencakup semua aturan umum untuk penawaran dan bervariasi tergantung pada promosi tertentu. Berikut adalah aturan umum yang berlaku untuk sebagian besar bonus MelBet: - **Kelayakan:** Hanya pengguna terdaftar yang telah melengkapi profil mereka (nama, nomor telepon, email, dll.) yang berhak mendapatkan bonus. Beberapa penawaran mungkin mengharuskan untuk ikut serta dalam promosi. - **Batas Waktu:** Sebagian besar bonus kedaluwarsa dalam waktu yang ditentukan (misalnya, 24 jam, 7 hari). Jika persyaratan taruhan tidak terpenuhi dalam jangka waktu tersebut, bonus dibatalkan. - **Pembatasan Permainan:** Beberapa bonus kasino hanya berlaku untuk permainan tertentu, sementara yang lain mengecualikan permainan tertentu. - **Penggabungan Bonus:** Beberapa bonus tidak dapat digunakan secara bersamaan kecuali dinyatakan sebaliknya. Beberapa promosi tidak dapat digabungkan. - **Pembatasan Penarikan:** Jika Anda meminta penarikan sebelum memenuhi persyaratan taruhan, bonus dan kemenangan apa pun darinya dapat hangus. - **Penyalahgunaan Bonus:** Jika MelBet mendeteksi aktivitas penipuan, akun duplikat, atau penyalahgunaan bonus, mereka dapat membatalkan bonus dan kemenangan atau bahkan memblokir akun. - **Kedaluwarsa Bonus:** Dana bonus yang tidak digunakan atau putaran gratis biasanya kedaluwarsa setelah periode tertentu, jadi selalu periksa ketentuan spesifiknya.

promotions.title: **MelBet – بیشترین بونوس سایت شرط بندی**
promotions.source_text: MelBet یک سایت شرط بندی با بونوس شناخته‌شده است که پیشنهادهای ویژه آن، فرصت‌های بیشتری را برای برد بدون هیچ ریسکی در اختیار شما قرار می‌دهد. هر بونوس به‌گونه‌ای طراحی شده است تا هیجان بیشتر، شانس‌های بالاتر و اعتماد به‌نفس بیشتری در شرط‌های شما ایجاد کند. علاوه بر این، این بونوس‌ها به بازیکنان کمک می‌کنند تا ویژگی‌ها، بازی‌ها و استراتژی‌های جدید را کشف کنند. promotions.title: **Comment utiliser un bonus MelBet pour parier**
promotions.source_text: Si vous vous demandez comment utiliser un bonus sur MelBet, sachez que c’est très simple. Il est fortement recommandé de ne pas manquer l’occasion de bénéficier des promotions. promotions.source_text: በመለያዎ ውስጥ በጉርሻ ቅናሾች ውስጥ መሳተፍን ማንቃት አለብዎት፡ ወደ የእኔ መለያ(My Account) → መለያ ቅንብሮች(Settings) → ጉርሻዎች(Bonuses) → ስፖርቶች(Sports) ይሂዱ። በ24 ሰአታት ውስጥ የቦነሱን መጠን 6 እጥፍ መወራረድ አለቦት። ውርርዶች የአኩሙሌተር ውርርድ (የብዙ ክስተቶች ጥምር) መሆን አለባቸው። እያንዳንዱ አኩሙሌተር ቢያንስ 3 ምርጫዎች ሊኖሩት ይገባል። እያንዳንዱ ምርጫ 1.65 ወይም ከዚያ በላይ ዕድሎች ሊኖሩት ይገባል። መወራረዱን በ24 ሰአታት ውስጥ ካላጠናቀቁ፣ ጉርሻው ጊዜው ያልፍበታል። MelBet የረቡዕ ጉርሻ ይህ በሜልቤት ረቡዕ የእርስዎ እድለኛ አሸናፊ ሊሆን ይችላል! በ”ፈጣን ጨዋታዎች ቀን” ማስታወቂያ፣ በተቀማጭዎ ላይ 100% ጉርሻ፣ እስከ 111 ዩኤስዶላር (ወይም ተመሳሳይ መጠን በሌላ ምንዛሬ) ማግኘት ይችላሉ። ደንቦቹ እንደሚከተለው ናቸው: የሚፈለገው ዝቅተኛው የተቀማጭ ገንዘብ 2 ዶላር ነው (ወይንም በአገር ውስጥ ተመጣጣኝ ምንዛሪ )። ጉርሻ ከሌሎች ማስታወቂያዎች ጋር ሊጣመር አይችልም። ሁሉም ፈጣን ጨዋታዎች ብቁ አይደሉም – የማይካተቱ ርዕሶች Lucky Wheel, Crash, Jackpot Game, Royal Feast እና ሌሎች ያካትታሉ. ወደ ቦነስ አካውንትዎ ይቀይሩ እና ከፈጣን ጨዋታዎች ክፍል ሆነው ጉርሻውን በጨዋታዎች 30 ጊዜ ይጫወቱ። ጉርሻውን ከተቀበለ በኋላ ይህ በ 24 ሰዓታት ውስጥ መደረግ አለበት። ሙሉው ውርርድ ካልተጠናቀቀ ጉርሻው እና ማንኛቸውም አሸናፊዎች ከ24 ሰዓታት በኋላ ይሰረዛሉ። ውርርዱ እንደተጠናቀቀ የሚቆጠረው በጉርሻ የተጫወቱት ሁሉም ጨዋታዎች ሲጠናቀቁ ብቻ ነው። ተቀማጭ ከማድረግዎ በፊት ገንዘቦችን ካወጡ ጉርሻው ገቢ አይሆንም። ከተሳካ፣ እስከ ዋናው የጉርሻ መጠን ድረስ የተረፈው የጉርሻ ገንዘብ ወደ ዋናው ሒሳብዎ ይተላለፋል። የጉርሻ መለያህ ከዝቅተኛው የአክሲዮን መጠን ያነሰ ከሆነ፣ የተቀረው ጉርሻ ተሰርዟል። MelBet የአርብ ጉርሻ

promotions.source_text: የጥሬ ገንዘብ (ካሽባክ)ተመላሽ ጉርሻ ተጫዋቾች የኪሳራቸዉን መቶኛ እንደ ቦነስ ፈንድ የሚቀበሉበት ማስታወቂያ ነው። ይህ ዓይነቱ ጉርሻ ለተጫዋቾች የጠፉትን ውርርድ መልሶ ለማግኘት ሁለተኛ እድል በመስጠት አደጋዎችን ለመቀነስ ይረዳል። የመመለሻ ጉርሻዎች በየቀኑ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ ፣ የመመለሻ ጉርሻዎች በየቀኑ፣ በየሳምንቱ ወይም ከተወሰኑ ጨዋታዎች ወይም ዝግጅቶች ጋር የተሳሰሩ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ እና ብዙ ጊዜ በትንሹ ወይም ምንም የውርርድ መስፈርቶች ጋር ይመጣሉ፣ ይህም ለመደበኛ ተጫዋቾች ጠቃሚ ሽልማት ያደርጋቸዋል። የጥሬ ገንዘብ ተመላሽ ብዙውን ጊዜ በስፖርት ዝግጅቶች ላይ ለውርርድ ወይም የቁማር ጨዋታዎችን ለመጫወት በሚጠቅሙ የጉርሻ ነጥቦች ውስጥ ይስተዋላል። ከ“ዋና መለያ” ይልቅ “የጉርሻ ነጥቦችን” መምረጥ ብቻ ያስፈልግዎታል፡- ![በሞባይል ሥሪት ላይ ከጉርሻ ነጥቦች ጋር ውርርድ](https://guidebook.melbet.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/bet-with-bonus-points-mobile-version-498x1024.jpg) MelBet የሞባይል ድረ ገጽ ስሪት ![በዴስክቶፕ ላይ ከጉርሻ ነጥቦች ጋር ውርርድ](https://guidebook.melbet.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/bet-with-bonus-points-desktop-1024x518.png) MelBet የዴስክቶፕ ስሪት በሜልቤት ላይ ያሉ ተወራራጆች በተለይ “በመተግበሪያው ውስጥ ያለው ሳምንታዊ ገንዘብ ተመላሽ” በጣም ያደንቃሉ ምክንያቱም እጅግ በጣም ተመጣጣኝ መስፈርቶች አሉት፡ የሜልቤት መተግበሪያን ብቻ ይጫኑ፣ አንዳንድ ውርርድ ያስቀምጡ እና 10% ተመላሽ ገንዘብ ይቀበሉ። በእርግጠኝነት ስለ MelBet ሳምንታዊ የገንዘብ ተመላሽ ገንዘብ የበለጠ መማር እና የጉርሻ ህጎችን መመልከት ጠቃሚ ነው። በተጨማሪም አፕሊኬሽኑን ከተጠቀሙ እና ለሳምንት በየቀኑ ውርርድ ካስቀመጡ ከሜልቤት ለዕለታዊ ጉርሻ ፕሮግራም ብቁ ይሆናሉ። «የገንዘብ ተመላሽ ሽልማቶች» ይባላል እና ለጠቅላላ ኪሳራዎ 3% ተመላሽ ገንዘብ ይሰጣል።

promotions.source_text: Syarat dan Ketentuan adalah seperangkat aturan, panduan, dan perjanjian hukum yang mendefinisikan bagaimana suatu layanan, produk, atau penawaran dapat digunakan. Syarat dan Ketentuan Bonus MelBet mencakup semua aturan umum untuk penawaran dan bervariasi tergantung pada promosi tertentu. Berikut adalah aturan umum yang berlaku untuk sebagian besar bonus MelBet: - **Kelayakan:** Hanya pengguna terdaftar yang telah melengkapi profil mereka (nama, nomor telepon, email, dll.) yang berhak mendapatkan bonus. promotions.source_text: بونوس کش‌بک یک نوع پروموشن است که در آن بازیکنان درصدی از باخت‌های خود را به‌صورت اعتبار بونوس دریافت می‌کنند. این نوع بونوس با دادن فرصتی دوباره به بازیکنان برای جبران بخشی از شرط‌های از دست‌رفته، به کاهش ریسک کمک می‌کند. بونوس‌های کش‌بک می‌توانند به‌صورت روزانه، هفتگی یا مرتبط با بازی‌ها یا رویدادهای خاص ارائه شوند و معمولاً دارای شرایط شرط‌بندی کم یا حتی بدون شرط‌بندی هستند، که آن‌ها را به پاداشی ارزشمند برای بازیکنان دائمی تبدیل می‌کند. کش‌بک اغلب به‌صورت امتیازات بونوس ارائه می‌شود که می‌توان از آن‌ها برای شرط‌بندی روی رویدادهای ورزشی یا انجام بازی‌های کازینویی استفاده کرد. کافی است به‌جای «حساب اصلی»، گزینه «امتیازات بونوس» را انتخاب کنید: ![شرط بندی با امتیاز جایزه در نسخه موبایل](https://guidebook.melbet.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/bet-with-bonus-points-mobile-version-498x1024.jpg) نسخه موبایل وب‌سایت MelBet ![شرط بندی با امتیاز جایزه در دسکتاپ](https://guidebook.melbet.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/bet-with-bonus-points-desktop-1024x518.png) نسخه دسکتاپ MelBet شرط‌بندان در MelBet به‌ویژه از «کش‌بک هفتگی در اپلیکیشن» استقبال می‌کنند، زیرا شرایط بسیار ساده‌ای دارد: کافی است اپلیکیشن MelBet را نصب کنید، چند شرط ببندید و ۱۰٪ کش‌بک دریافت کنید. قطعاً ارزش دارد که بیشتر درباره کش‌بک هفتگی MelBet بدانید و قوانین بونوس را بررسی کنید. علاوه بر این، اگر از اپلیکیشن استفاده کنید و به مدت یک هفته هر روز شرط‌بندی انجام دهید، واجد شرایط برنامه بونوس روزانه MelBet خواهید شد. این برنامه «پاداش‌های کش‌بک» نام دارد و ۳٪ کش‌بک از مجموع باخت‌های شما ارائه می‌دهد.

promotions.source_text: Usually offers that provide cashback, free spins, and free bets are considered no deposit bonuses. That means users do not need to deposit any money to receive rewards. Some cashbacks, free spins, and free bet bonuses go under the “No deposit” category at MelBet because players do not need to deposit any amount. However, to be eligible for those bonuses they have to follow other requirements like placing bets on certain events or others. MelBet Cashback A cashback bonus is a promotion where players receive a percentage of their losses back as bonus funds. This type of bonus helps reduce risks by giving players a second chance to recover some of their lost bets. Cashback bonuses can be daily, weekly, or tied to specific games or events and often come with minimal or no wagering requirements, making them a valuable reward for regular players. The cashback is often realized in bonus points that can be used to bet on sports events or to play gambling games. You just need to choose the “Bonus points” instead of “Main account”: MelBet mobile website version MelBet desktop version Bettors at MelBet especially appreciate the “Weekly cashback in the app” because it has extremely affordable requirements: just install the MelBet app, place some bets, and receive 10% cashback. It’s definitely worth learning more about the MelBet weekly cashback and looking through the bonus rules. Besides, if you use the application and place bets every day for a week, you become eligible for the daily bonus program from MelBet. It’s called “Cashback rewards” and grants a 3% cashback on your total losses. Loyalty Program MelBet rewards its players with an exclusive loyalty program featuring 8 exciting levels. These requirements vary based on the type of bonus. General wagering rules: Minimum Deposit Requirement: Most bonuses require a minimum deposit to activate, such as 2 USD, 10 USD, or more, depending on the offer. Multiplier Requirement: Most MelBet bonuses must be wagered a set number of times (e.g., 5x, 30x). promotions.title: MelBet Bonus Day
promotions.source_text: MelBet Bonus Day There are 3 happy days for MelBet users when they get generous bonuses: Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Every promotion comes with its own set of wagering requirements, terms and conditions, so be sure to review the rules carefully to make the most of your rewards. MelBet Monday Bonus “Royal Monday” is another popular promo MelBet offers for its users. The bookmaker and online casino thinks that Mondays should not be tough and wants to cheer bettors with some extra cash. The MelBet Monday Bonus rules are the following: You can receive 100% of your deposit as a bonus, up to a maximum of 100 USD (or the equivalent in another currency). The minimum deposit to qualify is $5. You must enable participation in bonus offers in your account: go to My Account → Account Settings → Bonuses → Sports. You must wager 6 times the bonus amount within 24 hours. Bets must be accumulator bets (a combo of multiple events). Each accumulator must have at least 3 selections. Each selection must have odds of 1.65 or higher. If you don’t complete the wagering within 24 hours, the bonus will expire. MelBet Wednesday Bonus This could be your lucky winning Wednesday at MelBet! With the “Fast Games Day” promotion, you can get a 100% bonus on your deposit, up to 111 USD (or the same amount in another currency). The rules are as follows: The minimum deposit required is 2 USD (or its equivalent in your local currency). Bonus cannot be combined with other promotions.

promotions.title: Bonus Abuse:
promotions.source_text: Bonus Abuse: If MelBet detects fraudulent activity, duplicate accounts, or bonus abuse, they can cancel the bonus and winnings or even block the account. Bonus Expiry: Unused bonus funds or free spins typically expire after a set period, so always check the specific terms. MelBet Bonus Wagering Requirements MelBet bonuses come with wagering requirements which are specific conditions that determine how many times you must bet the bonus before cashing out. These requirements vary based on the type of bonus. General wagering rules: Minimum Deposit Requirement: Most bonuses require a minimum deposit to activate, such as 2 USD, 10 USD, or more, depending on the offer. Multiplier Requirement: Most MelBet bonuses must be wagered a set number of times (e.g., 5x, 30x). For example, if you receive a 20 USD bonus with a 5x wagering requirement, you must place 100 USD in qualifying bets before withdrawal (20 USD × 5 = 100 USD). Bet Type Restrictions: Many bonuses require accumulator bets, where: each bet must contain a minimum number of selections (e.g., 3 or more), each selection must have minimum odds (e.g., 1.40, 1.65, etc.). MelBet Bonus Wagering Requirements MelBet bonuses come with wagering requirements which are specific conditions that determine how many times you must bet the bonus before cashing out. These requirements vary based on the type of bonus. General wagering rules: Minimum Deposit Requirement: Most bonuses require a minimum deposit to activate, such as 2 USD, 10 USD, or more, depending on the offer. Multiplier Requirement: Most MelBet bonuses must be wagered a set number of times (e.g., 5x, 30x). For example, if you receive a 20 USD bonus with a 5x wagering requirement, you must place 100 USD in qualifying bets before withdrawal (20 USD × 5 = 100 USD). promotions.source_text: Bonus Abuse: If MelBet detects fraudulent activity, duplicate accounts, or bonus abuse, they can cancel the bonus and winnings or even block the account. Bonus Expiry: Unused bonus funds or free spins typically expire after a set period, so always check the specific terms. MelBet Bonus Wagering Requirements MelBet bonuses come with wagering requirements which are specific conditions that determine how many times you must bet the bonus before cashing out. These requirements vary based on the type of bonus. General wagering rules: Minimum Deposit Requirement: Most bonuses require a minimum deposit to activate, such as 2 USD, 10 USD, or more, depending on the offer. Multiplier Requirement: Most MelBet bonuses must be wagered a set number of times (e.g., 5x, 30x). For example, if you receive a 20 USD bonus with a 5x wagering requirement, you must place 100 USD in qualifying bets before withdrawal (20 USD × 5 = 100 USD). Bet Type Restrictions: Many bonuses require accumulator bets, where: each bet must contain a minimum number of selections (e.g., 3 or more), each selection must have minimum odds (e.g., 1.40, 1.65, etc.).
